changes.title: Reuse unchanged statistics registry identities
changes.text: Avoid recalculating the same statistics schema fingerprint for every observation while preserving existing cache identities and late registration.

changes.title: Check registry compatibility during concurrent registration
changes.text: Verify unchanged cache identities, duplicate handling and coordinated readers after newly registered statistics.

changes.title: Record measured optimization and exact audit checkpoints
changes.text: Retain local benchmark evidence, current-source verification status and an honest per-file audit reconciliation.

commentary: I reduced repeated work when opening recorded statistics without changing the data or its cache identity. Existing history is preserved, and the complete UIMSD audit remains underway.
